title: Index-tree revision materializer
failure_signature: The owner-manifest checker passed a colon as though it were a tree revision, but git ls-tree requires a materialized tree-ish.
trigger_preconditions: A checker accepts a revision and the intended domain is the current Git index.
Index stage syntax is confused with a tree object accepted by ls-tree.
candidate_workaround: Materialize the exact index with git write-tree and pass the resulting tree object to the revision checker.
recurrence_guard: Use stage syntax only for individual index paths; use an exact write-tree object for index-wide tree operations.
rollback: Retain the failed check, make no manifest-parity claim from it, and leave the staged index unchanged.
scope_boundary: Read-only validation of the owned staged tree only.
